[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: lively accordion-like pulse-wave lead with quick grace-note runs
busy bell-buoy chimes and bright sparkle on phrase ends
light tambourine on beats two and three, brush on the downbeat
seaside festival dance, celebratory, playful and a little cheeky
seamless transition back to the theme
